_about: Chooms! accounts (docs/design.md, Chooms!: Accounts). kind: cast (shows once V has met them; may follow V and send a Choom Request), figure (shows once V is aware of them; posts only if V follows), delamain (like the cast, with DMs), corp (posts by district; no requests, no DMs), gang (C3: posts only while V is in one of its districts, at most one gang post per cycle; no requests, no DMs; affiliations are the game's Factions records, for the fights V has with them). requestAt (C3): the story point after which a cast member sends V a Choom Request. game (C2): V has met them when one of their codex character entries is unlocked or one of their contacts is known; they have died when a condition in dead holds (a contact known, or a story point passed, from story.json). Ids seen in the user's saves on 2026-11-14 unless listed in unverified. Corporations' districts checked against the game's codex on 2026-11-14 (docs/design.md, C2: built); Militech's and Petrochem's Badlands and all of Kang Tao's are still a guess. Gangs' districts (2026-11-25): the game's own table (TweakDB, each top district's gangs: Watson Maelstrom, Westbrook the Mox and the Tyger Claws, Heywood the Valentinos, Santo Domingo 6th Street, Pacifica the Voodoo Boys and the Animals, the Badlands the Aldecaldos, Dogtown the Barghest); added from the world, not in that table: the Tyger Claws and the Mox in Watson (Kabuki, Little China), the Wraiths in the Badlands, the Scavengers in Watson, Heywood and Santo Domingo.
